title: Pre-modded 22GB RTX 2080 Ti cards surface on eBay for $500 as VRAM-hungry local AI fans chase down every spare FLOP Hong Kong-based seller offers AI-friendly memory mod for a reasonable price
summary: Pre-modded 22GB RTX 2080 Ti cards are available on eBay for $500, making high-capacity graphics options accessible to users without the ability to upgrade their existing cards. This move is likely driven by the increasing demand for AI-friendly graphics cards. The pre-modded cards can cater to the needs of VRAM-hungry local AI fans.
insight: Increased accessibility of high-capacity graphics cards drives AI adoption

title: After severe 76% electricity price hikes due to AI data centers, Virginia requires firms to pay for all dedicated upstream electrical infrastructure state regulators crack down, governor says move will save civilians hundreds of millions of dollars
summary: Virginia requires data centers to pay for dedicated upstream electrical infrastructure, a policy shift to protect ratepayers from high costs. This move is expected to save civilians hundreds of millions of dollars. It marks one of the first states to implement this change.
insight: Data centers now bear infrastructure costs, not ratepayers.

title: $1 billion of iPhone 18 Pro chips 'on the shelves awaiting packaging' due to DRAM shortages memory shortages reportedly put a wrinkle in Apple's launch plans
summary: Apple has $1 billion worth of iPhone 18 processor wafers waiting packaging due to DRAM shortages, which have impacted the company's launch plans.
insight: DRAM shortages stall Apple's iPhone 18 launch and production momentum.

title: Nashville attempts to block controversial data center near zoo with eminent domain city could force developer to sell the land for public use, rather than $700 million installation
summary: Nashville Metro Council uses eminent domain to acquire land for a data center near the zoo, forcing the developer to give up the land. The city plans to prevent the $700 million installation. The developer still has a legal avenue to challenge the action.
insight: Nashville prioritizes public interests over private developer's multimillion-dollar project plans

title: Samsung debuts three next-generation memory technologies for AI data centers zHBM, zNAND-O, and BV-NAND all rely on advanced wafer bonding technologies
summary: Samsung unveils three next-gen memory technologies, zHBM, zNAND-O, and BV-NAND, relying on advanced wafer-bonding techniques.
insight: Accelerating AI workloads with innovative memory solutions and advanced bonding techniques.

title: PC gamer vibe-codes a safeguard against RTX 5090 power connector failures monitors per-pin power draw, shuts down system if it exceeds 9.5A for more than 15 seconds
summary: This application provides a safeguard against RTX 5090 power connector failures by monitoring power draw per-pin and shutting down the system if it exceeds 9.5A for more than 15 seconds. The 35MB application is a preventative measure to prevent damage or overheating. It allows for customizable power limits.
insight: Prevents RTX 5090 overheating and damage due to power draw issues

title: Sandisk Optimus GX 7100M 2TB SSD review: The best 2230 drive you can buy for the Steam Deck
summary: The Sandisk Optimus GX 7100M is a top-tier M.2 2230 SSD offering high performance and great power efficiency, available up to 2TB. It provides excellent support for the Steam Deck and other compact devices. This drive is ideal for gamers and professionals who require fast storage solutions.
insight: Optimized for Steam Deck, delivering ultra-fast storage on the go

title: Apple is taking OpenAI to court over alleged theft of trade secrets ChatGPT maker suggests it doesn't want Cupertino's knowledge anyway
summary: Apple is suing OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft by ex-employees. OpenAI denies the claims, citing misinformation. The case involves key Apple technologies and secrets.
insight: Tech giants clash over intellectual property and innovation dominance.

title: Token Monitor An ESP32-S3 desktop display that tracks AI coding assistant usage (Crowdfunding)
summary: Token Monitor is a desktop display tracking real-time AI coding assistant usage, showcasing usage information and estimated costs.
insight: Real-time AI coding assistant usage tracking for cost optimization and resource management.

title: Proxmox VE now officially supports 64-bit Arm (Aarch64) targets
summary: Proxmox VE 9.2 now supports 64-bit Arm (aarch64) targets, mirroring its x86-64 version. It relies on Debian 13.5 and Linux 7.0, and offers full support for NVIDIA Grace Hopper and Vera platforms. Best-effort support is available on other UEFI-based Armv8-A/Armv9-A hardware.
insight: Expanded Arm support enables greater flexibility and device options.

title: PICOTTY project enables multi-target serial remote management through Raspberry Pi Pico boards and Pi Zero 2 W SBC
summary: PICOTTY is an open-source project enabling serial-based remote management of multiple targets using Raspberry Pi boards. A Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W acts as a hub, running a web server for a dashboard, while Raspberry Pi Pico boards control and monitor targets over serial. This allows for IP keyboard-like functionality without video or mouse support.
insight: Multi-target remote management for headless systems is now more accessible.

title: Roger Grace MEMS report validates the rising role of AI
summary: MEMS technology has reached maturity with AI playing a growing role according to the 2025 Roger Grace Commercialization Report Card. Thought leaders gave a B-minus grade, consistent with the past three years. This indicates a significant increase in the application of AI in MEMS.
insight: AI drives innovation in mature MEMS technology applications.

title: Best of Sensors: TI charges ahead with Dynamic Z-Track
summary: Texas Instruments won Best of Sensors 2026 for its single-chip battery management solution. The solution includes a fuel gauge, monitor, and protector for lithium-ion battery packs. This innovation enhances power and sustainability in battery-powered devices.
insight: Enhancing battery life and sustainability with single-chip management solutions.

title: Nintendo's Switch 2 sells over 23 million units in its first year, outpacing the original's 17 million
summary: The Nintendo Switch 2 has sold 23 million units in its first year, surpassing the original's 17 million. This achievement marks a significant milestone for the console, outpacing its predecessor's sales. The Switch 2's success shows its strong market appeal.
insight: Nintendo Switch 2 cements its position as a gaming market leader.

title: Kioxia's new PCIe 6.0 SSDs want to feed GPUs data at a fraction of HBM's price
summary: Kioxia's GP1 Series SSDs offer fast data transfer via PCIe 6.0 and NVMe 2.2 protocol, serving as a middle ground between traditional storage and high-bandwidth memory (HBM). This technology aims to provide a cost-effective alternative to expensive HBM solutions for GPUs. The SSDs target the enterprise market with their high-speed capabilities.
insight: Affordable, high-speed storage for GPUs could revolutionize data-intensive applications.

title: Thousands of server motherboards are vulnerable to controller flaws that could give attackers hardware-level control
summary: Thousands of server motherboards are vulnerable to controller flaws, allowing attackers to gain hardware-level control. Baseboard management controllers (BMCs) are small computers built into enterprise servers, enabling remote management and monitoring. BMC flaws can compromise server security.
insight: Vulnerable BMCs grant attackers root-level access to enterprise servers.

title: Dolby Vision 2 is rolling out now, starting with select Hisense TVs
summary: Dolby Vision 2, a successor to Dolby's dynamic HDR format, is rolling out with select Hisense TVs. This upgrade offers improved brightness and color adjustments on a scene-by-scene basis. The rollout follows Dolby's September unveiling.
insight: Enhanced HDR experience with scene-by-scene color and brightness adjustment

title: Corsair acquires Trak Racer, adding premium racing cockpits and flight sim gear to its lineup
summary: Corsair acquires Trak Racer, expanding its sim-racing equipment offerings with premium cockpits and seats.
insight: Enhanced sim-racing experience for enthusiasts with combined expertise and gear.

title: Google's AI told people Flock cameras were full of gold. They weren't.
summary: Flock's AI mistakenly confirmed surveillance cameras contained gold, causing confusion online.
insight: Misinterpretation of humor highlights AI's limitations and trust issues.

title: Netflix and Disney are now considering free, ad-supported streaming
summary: Disney and Netflix consider ad-supported streaming options for price-sensitive customers.
insight: Free streaming services could tap into underserved, price-conscious consumer segments.

title: AI slop, privacy fears, and endless scrolling are making people fall out of love with the internet
summary: People are losing affection for the internet due to data breaches, AI slop, and endless scrolling.
insight: Internet fatigue sets in as users fear data exploitation.

summary: Uber plans to spend $10 billion on 120,000 robotaxis across 15 cities, leveraging strong cash flow from its core business.
insight: Uber's robust cash flow enables significant investment in autonomous future.

title: Researchers found a way to steal passkeys straight out of Chrome's memory
summary: Malware can read passkey data from Google Chrome's memory, compromising user accounts.
insight: Massive account access and vulnerability through Chrome memory exploitation.

title: Nvidia turns RTX 5000 GPUs at MSRP into one of QuakeCon's biggest attractions
summary: Nvidia turned RTX 5000 GPUs at MSRP into a QuakeCon attraction, marking a notable event. This occurred during the 20th anniversary celebration of QuakeCon, which took place at the Gaylord Texan Resort in Grapevine, Texas. The event showcased Nvidia's GPUs.
insight: Nvidia's affordable GPUs draw gamers to QuakeCon's 20th anniversary celebration.

title: Sharpest-ever images of the sun reveal tiny plasma whirlpools scientists have chased for decades
summary: Researchers have captured sharpest-ever images of the sun's surface, revealing tiny plasma whirlpools. The patterns match Kelvin-Helmholtz instability, a phenomenon observed in fluids and plasmas. This discovery was made possible by a 4-meter telescope.
insight: Understanding sun's plasma dynamics improves solar energy and space weather forecasting

title: Gears of War: E-Day open beta kicks off today, and PVP made it in after all
summary: The Gears of War: E-Day open beta starts today, with a pre-order access phase from August 6 to 10 for early subscribers and an open beta from August 13 to 17.
insight: Exclusive early access for pre-order customers and subscribers matters.
